Players Committee card image of [[General Carlist Rieekan (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploys -1 to a war room. While at a war room, your capital starships at Rebel Base systems may not be targeted by weapons and your Rebels and T-47s at same and related Rebel Base locations move for free to same or related locations.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/generalcarlistrieekan.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.
